exclusion_reason: Units exposed in field-QA development evaluation; no gold answers read

forward_year.estimand: later year on potentially previously observed units of same farm; not new-field generalization

geometry.aoi_rule: convex hull of sampling locations buffered 15 metres; research support only
geometry.sensitivity_required: Compare EPSG:26913 and EPSG:32613 transforms plus cardinal 15 m and 30 m shifts; report changes without selecting by label performance

limitation: Exploratory one-farm assessment, 12 physical groups; adjacent units and imagery contexts remain dependent. Physical label-group holdout is not spatially disjoint imagery holdout. No external-farm generalization or agronomic validation. Targets are sample-location means, never whole-field harvest yields.

models.baseline: training crop majority with lexical tie break; training per-crop mean yield
models.crop: train-only StandardScaler; LogisticRegression C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=2000, random_state=0
models.missingness: no imputation; unavailable vectors excluded from fitting, retained as evaluation failures
models.yield: separate per-crop train-only StandardScaler and Ridge alpha=1; minimum two training seasons

representations.alias_audit: report exact duplicate feature vectors and maximum pairwise cosine similarity; no feature selection
representations.prithvi: 192-D mean tokens over exactly four chronological dates, weighted by valid sampled-support pixels per 16x16 patch/date, requiring positive valid support each date; actual 224x224 native-30m context primary; missing pixels normalized nodata 0.0001, no resizing; small-chip center nodata-padding only as separate sensitivity
representations.prithvi_boundary: 480m token and 6.72km context exceed management units; mixed context is not a spatially isolated field embedding

source_tabular.excluded_reason: target/identity shortcut, future seasonal covariate, or timing/availability unresolved
source_tabular.reason: 2018 soil sampling per dictionary; publication availability unknown

tasks.yield: arithmetic mean of yield-monitor-derived yield at available sampled locations

time.publication_time_status: unknown; retrospective acquisition-cutoff experiment, not operational forecast
time.selection_rule: latest QA-eligible acquisitions within window, chronological order; source item ID breaks ties; no target-aware selection
